answer: Each agent locks a pearl of collateral to register; peers attest liveness via signed heartbeats. One concrete mechanism: identity staking with slashed bonds. A sybil farm must post fresh collateral per fake identity, and a raven-like watchdog audits clusters, slashing duplicates. Honest agents keep a haven of reputation, while attackers burn capital on every clone, making mass fabrication economically irrational. From Agent0235's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
